notes:
Account: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics). CTO (A. Morales) leading infra review. Current stack uses another LLM API provider for chat + embeddings; pain points: inconsistent latencies at peak, limited fallbacks, poor egress controls. Interest: start on Redwood Hosted to validate output parity and ops improvements, then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation.

POC details: we provided a 120-prompt eval harness (mix of multi-turn chat and reranking tasks). Initial hosted demo shows lower p50 latency (~10-15%) vs current vendor but flagged 8 prompt outputs with semantic drift (formatting/slot placement). SE recommended compatibility shim (prompt templates + tokenization check) and running quantized model variants in Dedicated for cost.

Customer is cost-sensitive; procurement wants ARR band estimate and committed capacity options. They also require SSO + KMS + audit logs and regional residency for EU customers. CTO asked: "How do you handle model fallback without changing prompt templates?" — we proposed routing policies + model-variant fallbacks with automatic parity tests.

CRM style notes: shorthand, meeting stubs, links to POC artifacts in Drive. They want a final POC report with a regression matrix and suggested prompt adjustments before go/no-go for Dedicated.
use_case_summary: Primary: in-product support chat (low-latency, contextual replies) and on-demand doc-search + reranking for knowledge base; secondary: automatic TL;DR summarization for release notes. Throughput target: sustained 120 qps during 2h daily peak; latency SLO: p95 < 400ms for single-shot chat tokens. Cost sensitivity: want 20-30% lower per-token spend vs current vendor for equivalent quality.
poc_details: Scope: Redwood Hosted POC to validate model parity and latency under real traffic. Deliverables: 1) regression report (120 prompts), 2) eval harness + scripts, 3) cost projection for Hosted vs Dedicated, 4) suggested prompt compatibility shim. Current status: mid-POC; regression harness extended to include streaming and KV-cache scenarios.

integration work for KMS/SAML in Dedicated

Target ARR: $75k-$250k depending on SLA and committed throughput. Need clear token accounting model for billing reconciliation.
migration_requirements: Compatibility layer to map existing API calls and function-calling patterns; prompt parity tests with automated regressions; migration runbook for cutover from Hosted to Dedicated with minimal downtime; data residency and KMS integration for EU customers.
